notes: Georgia's county-level "Ballots Issued and Accepted" and "Ballots to Date" downloads (from the state's election-data-hub dashboard, https://sos.ga.gov/page/election-data-hub-unofficial-turnout) are compared against the statewide absentee file, county by county, using whichever is higher - this is how same-day in-person early-voting activity (which the statewide absentee file doesn't carry until the next overnight refresh) gets folded in. No district or demographic breakdown is available from these county-level downloads.
Louisiana does not publish mail ballot request data - the ballots requested figures shown for Louisiana equal ballots returned. Louisiana rreports statistics for Whites, Blacks, and other only.

data_source: Data provided by Michigan Secretary of State
notes: Michigan does not identify how voters cast their ballots. The in-person numbers differ from the state's dashboard in that in-person reported here is estimated from mail ballot application data.
North Carolina provides summary ballot request statistics available for counties only. No mail ballot request statistics by district are available.

The statewide and county statistics are compiled from the state dashobard. The district and age statistics are from an individual level file which may have slightly different statistics than the state's summary report, which the state did not update on Friday
South Carolina's in-person early-voting total (by county) comes from a separate report with no race or Hispanic ethnicity breakdown; the race/ethnicity figures shown reflect mail ballots only.
